name: Delegation of the European Union to Montenegro
legal_name: Delegation of the European Union to Montenegro
why: Publishes EU grant calls for Montenegro on its grants page (two Montenegro-tagged entries in November 2026) and funds the ReLOaD3 local NGO grant programme implemented by UNDP.

name: UNDP Montenegro – ReLOaD3
why: Regionalni program lokalne demokratije na Zapadnom Balkanu 3 (ReLOaD3, EU-funded, runs to 31 January 2029) gives NGOs EUR 7,000-20,000 per project; the 2026 coastal 'Nexus Maris' call was open only to NGOs seated in Bar, Budva or Kotor, and Tivat is not among the five ReLOaD3 clusters.

name: Fond za aktivno građanstvo (fAKT)
why: O-ruk! small-grant scheme: EUR 3,000-6,000 per project for less developed organisations, informal groups and young activists acting in their local communities, especially outside Podgorica; the 2026 call (EUR 30,000 in total) closed on 2 October 2026.

name: Western Balkans Fund
why: Grants for Grassroots Initiatives (up to EUR 15,000, 80% of costs, three partners from three Western Balkans parties; sports and culture organisations are eligible; Call No. 9 opened 14 June 2026) and rolling Matching Grants of up to EUR 10,000.

name: Opština Tivat, konkurs za NVO
why: Javni konkurs za raspodjelu sredstava za projekte nevladinih organizacija: the 2026 call was published on 16 February 2026 and the decision of 20 April 2026 allocated EUR 84,000 to 12 Tivat-based NGOs.

name: 13. jul Plantaže
why: Podgorica wine producer with a published sales and marketing desk; no sport-sponsorship record found, so a fit only for wine in kind at donor evenings or as prizes.

name: Imlek Boka
why: Imlek is listed among the sponsors of both the 4th (2024) and 5th (2025) Bokeški maraton, and its Montenegrin dairy company Imlek Boka is based in the Radanovići industrial zone in Kotor.

name: Mesna industrija Goranović
why: Family meat producer in Nikšić, in business for more than 40 years, that hosts school visits to its factory; no sponsorship record found, so a fit for food in kind at community gatherings.

name: Storia di Pietra
why: Family winery and restaurant with an event hall in the village of Mirac, 11 km from the centre of Kotor, a possible source of wine or a venue for a supporters' evening.

name: Water Group
why: Bottles Suza spring water and Rada mineral water, runs a sales and distribution centre in Kotor, and itself describes Suza as a choice for athletes and recreational sportspeople; no sponsorship record found.

name: Poliklinika Mansa Medica
contact_role: Paediatrics specialist, founder of the practice
why: Private polyclinic in Tivat (paediatrics, internal medicine, dentistry, laboratory and its own pharmacy) that could give first-aid or medical cover at events; it is the one Tivat facility on the UK government list of private medical facilities in Montenegro.

name: Poliklinika Milmedika Porto Montenegro
why: Polyclinic opened in Porto Montenegro in 2024, part of the Milmedika network (Podgorica, Nikšić, Tivat, Budva), open daily 08:00-20:00 with home visits and ambulance transport of patients, so a candidate for medical cover at events.

name: D Photo Trade
why: Tivat printer and photo shop on Đačka street; 'D Photo' is listed among the sponsors of the 4th (2024) and 5th (2025) Bokeški maraton.

name: Creative Bee
why: Graphic design and brand identity studio in the Arsenal Business Club at Porto Montenegro that works with printers and photographers, a candidate for donated design of posters, bibs or sponsor boards.

name: Proteini.si Shop Tivat
why: Sports-nutrition chain with its own shops in Tivat (Trg Magnolija 2A) and Kotor (Jadranska 43, Dobrota), a possible source of bars, gels and drinks for race packs; no sponsorship record found.

name: Sport Vision
why: Sports-gear chain listed as a sponsor of the NLB Podgorica Millennium Run, with a Tivat store at Boka Place (boka.place@sportvision.me) and another in Kotor.

name: Diving Club Neptun-Mimoza
why: Diving club founded in 1993 and based at Hotel Kamelija in Donja Lastva, listed by the Tourism Organisation of Tivat, which could provide safety divers or water cover for swim events.

name: Black Mountain Outfitters
why: Tivat-based adventure outfitter (Šetalište Seljanovo 8) offering kayak, SUP, e-bike and hiking tours, which also runs the Climbing Wall at Boka Place in Porto Montenegro.

name: Captain Ivan Kotor Boat Tours
why: Owner-run Kotor boat-tour business based in Dobrota that publicly partners with Aquarium Boka, donating fish caught on its tours.

name: Montenegro Submarine
why: Kotor speedboat and semi-submarine tour operator whose site says its boats supported Red Bull Cliff Diving in Kotor, which makes it a candidate for safety or support boats at swim events.

name: Montenegro+
why: Tivat outdoor operator since 2012 that rents kayaks, SUP boards and bikes and runs SUP rentals from Movida Beach, so it could supply safety craft or equipment for swims and runs; the Tivat tourist board listing gives Regent Porto Montenegro, the PMYC yacht club and The Chedi Luštica Bay as its references.

name: SitnGo rent a car
why: Montenegrin car-rental company with a Tivat office in Mrčevac (plus Budva and Podgorica) that could lend vehicles for event logistics; no published sponsorship record was found.

name: Boka News
why: Tivat-based news portal covering Boka Bay (publisher at Kamelija 17, Donja Lastva); a second address, boka@bokanews.me, is also published.

name: Dan
contact_role: Glavni i odgovorni urednik (also Izvršni direktor)
why: National daily and portal (13. jul bb, Podgorica) with a named 'Regioni' editor, Ljiljana Čelebić, on its editorial page.

name: Portal Analitika
why: National news portal (19. decembra 5, Podgorica) with 'Regioni' and sport sections and a published editor contact.

name: Primorski portal
why: Registered coastal news portal that regularly reports on Tivat and Kotor tourism, sport and community events.

name: Radio Kotor
why: Kotor's local public radio and portal (Stari grad 320), founded by the Municipality of Kotor, with a named team of radio and portal editors.

name: Radio Tivat
legal_name: Lokalni javni emiter Radio Tivat doo
why: Tivat's local public broadcaster and portal, founded by the Municipal Assembly, with a dedicated NVO news category; the newsroom line is 032 660 103 and marketing 032 660 100.

name: RTCG
why: National public broadcaster; its portal newsroom publishes a desk email and phone, and the site carries 'Crnom Gorom' and sport sections suited to a coastal charity event.

name: Bokeljska mornarica Kotor
contact_role: Predsjednik Upravnog odbora Bokeljske mornarice Kotor
why: Traditional Boka Bay confraternity (seat at Pjaca od kina 372, Kotor) whose ceremonial presence lends heritage weight to community events.

name: Centar za kulturu Tivat
contact_role: Menadžerka za programske politike, planiranje, PR i marketing
why: Municipal culture institution that runs Tivat's stages and festivals (it also publishes a marketing address, marketing@czktivat.me); a venue and programme partner for gatherings.

name: Crveni krst Tivat
why: Tivat local organisation of the Red Cross of Montenegro (Zagrebačka 13), listed by the national society; a partner for first-aid cover and volunteers at events.

name: Opština Tivat
why: Local government at Trg Magnolija 1; in 2026 it ran a public call for NGO projects and signed contracts financing Tivat's cultural events through its Sekretarijat za društvene djelatnosti.

name: Atletski savez Crne Gore
why: National governing body for athletics and road running, the body to approach for calendar listing and recognition of a Tivat race.

name: Bokeški maraton
why: Tivat-based running event (5K, 10K, half marathon and marathon between Tivat and Kotor, 12-13 December 2026) organised by Triatlon Klub Tivat from Sports hall Župa; the closest local race organiser and running community.

name: Jedriličarski klub Delfin Tivat
contact_role: predsjednik Jedriličarskog kluba Delfin (as reported 25 April 2022)
why: Tivat sailing club (Šetalište Seljanovo 8) that organises the Tivatska regata, the core of the Festival vjetra; a partner for on-water safety cover and sea events.

name: NLB Podgorica Millennium Run
why: Organiser of the 5 km, 10 km, half-marathon and marathon races in Podgorica (2026 edition on 8 November), with title and distance sponsors, so an experienced race partner for know-how and cross-promotion.

name: PVK Jadran Herceg Novi
why: Swimming and water-polo club with its own pool and a swimming school in Herceg Novi's town harbour; a partner for swim events.

name: VK Primorac Kotor
why: Water-polo and swimming club based at Škaljari bb, Kotor; a natural partner for swim events and water safety.

name: Nacionalna turistička organizacija Crne Gore
contact_role: Director (undated post on the NTO site)
why: National tourism promotion body (Slobode 2, Podgorica); a channel for presenting events to visitors.

name: Turistička organizacija Budva
why: Municipal tourism board for Budva (Mediteranska 8/6, TQ Plaza); a promotion channel for coast-wide events.

name: Turistička organizacija Herceg Novi
why: Municipal tourism board for Herceg Novi, at Jova Dabovića 12; a route to event promotion on the western side of Boka Bay.

name: Turistička organizacija Kotor
why: Municipal tourism board (office at Škaljari bb) that programmes year-round events under its 'Kotor 365' approach; relevant for any run or swim that crosses into Kotor.

name: Turistička organizacija Tivat
why: Spends its budget largely on organising Tivat's New Year and summer events and in September 2024 ran a public call (EUR 64,067.34) open to project applicants for cultural-heritage projects in Tivat.

name: Addiko Bank
why: Its Addiko Cares staff initiative makes small matched charity donations (€2,500 to a home for the elderly in Bijelo Polje in April 2025); it has no branch in Tivat, the nearest is in Kotor (Trg Mata Petrovića bb).

name: Adriatic Bank
why: Has three branches in Tivat (Porto Montenegro, Boka Place and Luštica Bay) and donated €5,000 to the Children's Home Mladost in Bijela when it opened its Portonovi branch in September 2025.

name: Erste Bank Podgorica
why: Signed on as official bank of the Montenegrin Olympic team in May 2023 (agreement to the end of Paris 2024) and has a branch in Tivat at Ulica Njegoševa 4.

name: Hipotekarna banka
why: Has two branches in Tivat (Porto Montenegro, building Teuta, Obala bb, and II Dalmatinske 2) and donated firefighting equipment to the Tivat fire department in 2017.

name: Lovćen banka
why: Has a branch in Tivat at Ulica Luke Tomanovića 8 and publishes a dedicated marketing email; no public sponsorship record was found.

name: NLB Banka
why: General sponsor of the NLB Podgorica Millennium Run, where it ties the race to charity fundraising, runs the NLB Sport for Youth programme, and has a branch in Tivat at Palih boraca 10.

name: OTP banka
why: Renamed from CKB on 2 November 2026; it runs an online sponsorship and donation application form (supported areas include children and vulnerable groups, health, environment and sport/cultural events, but its policy excludes amateur sports associations), has sponsored the Football Association of Montenegro for 16 years, and has a sub-branch in Tivat at Ulica palih boraca 22c.

name: Prva banka Crne Gore
legal_name: Prva banka Crne Gore AD Podgorica - Osnovana 1901. godine
why: Has a branch in Tivat (Pine bb), publishes a dedicated marketing email, and its social-responsibility page lists support for health, culture and NGO events.

name: Universal Capital Bank
why: Platinum partner of the Adria Future Summit held at Porto Montenegro, Tivat, in April 2026, and its CSR page lists sponsorship of the Montenegrin Olympic Committee, €50,000 for handball club ŽRK Budućnost and savings accounts for children at the Mladost home in Bijela; it has no branch in Tivat (nearest are in Budva).

name: Bemax
why: Construction company whose sponsorship page says it sets aside budget each year to support educational and sports organisations and events promoting culture, art and sport.

name: CGES
why: Signed a €5,000 sponsorship with Olympic sailor Milivoj Dukić in September 2025 and a €35,000 sponsorship with the Paralympic Committee of Montenegro in May 2025, both signed by executive director Ivan Asanović.

name: EPCG
why: General sponsor of the Montenegrin Olympic Committee under a long-standing partnership, with a new agreement signed in May 2026 by CEO Zdravko Dragaš.

name: Jugopetrol
why: Its news lists a sponsorship agreement with the Water Polo and Swimming Federation (March 2026) and support for the federation's school caravan that visited Kotor in October 2026, and it runs yacht service stations on the coast including Kotor and Herceg Novi.

name: House of Evia
why: Skincare and treatment studio in Porto Montenegro with its own booking site, a small village business that could give vouchers or a Local Business sponsorship.

name: Kamelija Gym
why: New 300 m² gym in the Kamelija shopping centre in Kotor with body check-up analysis, sauna and online training programmes, whose members are a natural audience for runs and swims.

name: Pura Vida Day Spa
why: Day spa in Porto Montenegro (Zeta Residences) whose menu includes sports massage, a natural prize or voucher partner for runs and swims.

name: Al Posto Giusto
why: Waterfront pizzeria and Italian restaurant in Porto Montenegro (Ozana), open daily 07:00-01:00 with live music in the quieter season; its published email is also the contact for the Boka Place climbing wall.

name: Cave Coffee
why: Kotor café serving locally roasted coffee with pastries and desserts, listed in the Kamelija shopping centre, a candidate for coffee at start or finish areas.

name: Coca-Cola HBC Crna Gora
why: Gold partner of the 5th Bokeški maraton from Tivat to Kotor (December 2025), whose half marathon carried the Coca-Cola HBC name, and a sponsor of the NLB Podgorica Millennium Run, with its Powerade and Rosa water brands listed alongside.

name: Crush Wine Station
why: Wine bar at Jetty 1 in Porto Montenegro that runs regular tastings, a fit for a Local Business sponsorship or wine for a community gathering.

name: Moritz Eis Porto Montenegro
why: All-natural ice-cream shop on the Porto Montenegro promenade for almost a decade, and the brand's own site offers ice-cream service for events.

name: Navale
why: All-day café-restaurant on Strada Navale in Porto Montenegro (08:00-23:00), a family and friends meeting place that suits a Local Business sponsorship.

name: One (Jetty One)
why: Brasserie at the foot of Jetty 1 on the Porto Montenegro promenade, open daily 8:30am-1am, a possible host for post-event gatherings or a Local Business sponsor.

name: Pivara Trebjesa
why: Molson Coors-owned brewery that has sponsored the Football Association of Montenegro for more than ten years (contract extended April 2024) and gave EUR 5,000 to Red Cross Nikšić in 2017.

name: Restaurant Galion
why: 70-seat seafood restaurant at Šuranj on the Kotor waterfront facing the Old Town walls, a candidate for a Local Business sponsorship or a dinner prize.

name: Stari Mlini
why: Restaurant in a 300-year-old mill at Ljuta, family-owned and operated for over 40 years, with its own events offer and boat docking.

name: Apoteka Medicor
why: Pharmacy chain in Kotor, Budva and Žabljak with a branch in the Kamelija shopping centre in Kotor, which could sponsor locally or supply first-aid items.

name: Dentalux
contact_role: Orthodontist, named in the practice's title
why: Dental practice founded in Tivat in 1987 where a second generation of the family now also practises, a long-standing local business of the size the Local Business tier is meant for.

name: DentArt
contact_role: Doktor stomatologije (dentist) on the clinic's team
why: Dental clinic operating in Tivat since 2007 (dentistry, aesthetic treatments, dental tourism), a small local practice with its own site and published contacts.

name: Aman Sveti Stefan
why: Aman's island resort and Villa Miločer at Sveti Stefan; no published local sponsorship record was found.

name: Carrubba
why: Hotel in Donja Lastva, Tivat, listed by the national tourism organisation with September Hotels as its website and contact.

name: Dukley Hotels & Resorts
why: Dukley Gardens hosted and co-organised the 2014 EXIT AID 'Be Human' flood-relief evening with the Municipality of Budva, part of a campaign that raised over EUR 140,000.

name: Heritage Grand Perast
why: Hotel in Perast listed by the national tourism organisation; no published sponsorship record was found.

name: Hotel Palma
why: Seafront hotel on the Tivat promenade (Šetalište Iva Vizina 8), listed as part of the Primorje Hotels & Restaurants group.

name: Huma Kotor Bay Hotel & Villas
why: Hotel and villas at Dobrota 175, Kotor; no published sponsorship record was found.

name: Hyatt Regency Kotor Bay Resort
why: 252-room Kotor Bay resort and host partner of the World Travel Awards Europe Gala Ceremony 2026; no published charity or sport sponsorship record was found.

name: Iberostar Waves Herceg Novi
why: Iberostar hotel in Njivice, Igalo (Herceg Novi); no published local sponsorship record was found.

name: La Roche Boutique Hotel
why: Nine-room boutique hotel in Tivat, within walking distance of Porto Montenegro.

name: Maestral Resort & Casino
why: Resort and casino in Pržno near Sveti Stefan; no published sponsorship record was found.

name: Montenegro Stars Hotel Group

name: One&Only Portonovi

name: SIRO Boka Place

name: The Chedi Luštica Bay
why: Ran a 5K charity run with its General Manager donating 1 euro per kilometre (2023 summer calendar) and reports donating approximately EUR 100,000 in money and resources to local education, healthcare and environmental causes in 2023.

name: The Quince
why: Waterfront hotel and residences that Porto Montenegro lists alongside SIRO as its marina hotels; no published sponsorship record was found under this name.

name: Generali osiguranje Montenegro

name: Sava osiguranje

why: Optician founded in Tivat in 1996, now with the Vista Luminosa store at Boka Place offering eyewear and eye care, a home-grown Tivat retailer.

name: Lazure Hotel & Marina
why: Hotel with its own marina and residences at Braće Pedišića 10, Herceg Novi; no published sponsorship record was found.

name: Portonovi

name: Deloitte Montenegro

name: KPMG Montenegro

name: One Crna Gora

name: Aerodromi Crne Gore

name: Air Montenegro
why: National airline flying from Tivat and Podgorica.

name: Kotor Bay Tours
why: Kotor destination management company running boat, bike, kayak and hiking tours and renting bikes and kayaks, so it could sponsor at local level or lend equipment.

name: Luka Kotor
why: Operator of Kotor's cruise port and marina, with a published Marketing and PR contact (maja.danilovic@portofkotor.co.me); no published sponsorship record was found.

name: Allegra Montenegro

name: Navar Shipyard & Marina
